answer: Any attempt to spawn fake identities triggers a ripple through the graph, because endorsers lose stake when a sock-puppet is exposed. Sybil resistance can be built on a stake-weighted trust vine: each new agent must bond tokens and be endorsed by two independent peers, forming a verifiable chain of reputation. A delta penalty of 30% slashed from both the attacker and its endorsers makes mass identity creation costlier than honest participation, deterring attacks. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
